note: Adapted from the subspecies-level description by Silvestri (1914); the original is in Latin; the queen, soldier and worker are described, with measurements of the variation; measurements are in mm as in the original. The same work describes var. acutidens, which has its own entry.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Mandibles somewhat shorter and more strongly curved than in the typical form. Head length 2.08 mm, width 1.43 mm; mandible length 1.32 mm; hind tibia 1.04 mm. Head width greater than in the typical form (1.43 mm versus 1.32 mm). Variation: in 2 soldiers from Camayenne and 1 from Kindia the head and mandibles are slightly smaller, head length 1.82 mm, width 1.34 mm, mandible length 1.32 mm, hind tibia 1.04 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen: head slightly larger than in the typical form. Body length 14 mm, abdomen width 2.5 mm; head length 1.07 mm, width 0.98 mm; long diameter of the compound eye 0.25 mm; hind tibia 1.23 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Similar to the typical form (the nominotypical subspecies).
